rspec_tour.description:
xl170 Narwhal WAN topology: single shared LAN, one client per validator.
N validators on one broadcast domain. Each validator also runs its own benchmark_client process (multi-client mode). Validator interfaces are shaped (25ms per interface -> 100ms RTT between validators).
Latency breakdown: node-i <-> node-j RTT: 25ms(i) + 25ms(i) + 25ms(j) + 25ms(j) = 100ms client on node-i -> own node-i: localhost (no LAN traversal)
